      description: The schema for all error responses.

      properties:

      title: Validation message

        message:
          title: Message

          type: string

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string

          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR),
            used to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this field is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (addressLine1, plus a single space and addressLine2 when
            addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when supplied; normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored and returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (unit, apartment
            etc.). Normalized the same way as addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's ageBand is derived from it, measured against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. The householdId is always computed deterministically from
            (lastName, postcode), so this flag no longer creates the household link. It only
            bypasses the household duplicate block: because owners sharing a lastName and postcode
            are the same household, a second such owner is rejected with 409 unless this flag is
            true, in which case it is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true

        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR who') when a title is supplied, or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678').
                Derived from the stored 'telephone', which stays raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household, keyed on
                (lastName, postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized lastName, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every
                owner with the same lastName (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace) and
                postcode receives the same value automatically, regardless of creation order.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1c9d8b7e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived key: the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the
                householdId, joined by '|'. Duplicate detection is now keyed on the household: a
                create request is rejected with 409 when an existing owner shares the new owner's
                householdId (same lastName and postcode), unless it declares 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email address
                is present; adds 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for tenure of more
                than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, bucketed from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the REGION component of the customerCode
                (the part before the first '-'), which is derived from the postcode.
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Null when the
                region has no known timezone (including 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it shared an existing owner's
                lastName (case-insensitive) and postcode while carrying a different telephone and
                was NOT a declared household member; otherwise false. A declared household member
                (created with 'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged. Assigned at registration
                and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of,

              type: integer

              minimum: 0

            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored email:

              description: >-

                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged
                deleted.
              type: boolean

            pets:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR),
            used to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this field is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (addressLine1, plus a single space and addressLine2 when
            addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when supplied; normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored and returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (unit, apartment
            etc.). Normalized the same way as addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's ageBand is derived from it, measured against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. The householdId is always computed deterministically from
            (lastName, postcode), so this flag no longer creates the household link. It only
            bypasses the household duplicate block: because owners sharing a lastName and postcode
            are the same household, a second such owner is rejected with 409 unless this flag is
            true, in which case it is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR who') when a title is supplied, or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678').
                Derived from the stored 'telephone', which stays raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the
                registrationDate. Derived from the owner's own customerCode and
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a July-December date reports the next
                calendar year's fiscal year (e.g. 2025-08-10 -> 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household, keyed on
                (lastName, postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized lastName, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every
                owner with the same lastName (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace) and

## Change: fiscal-year basis for date-derived values

The fiscal year starts **1 July** and is named by the calendar year it ends in (Australian convention), so a July–December date reports the *next* calendar year's fiscal year (e.g. `2026-08-10` → FY2027 → `FY27`).

**New shared utility** — `model/FiscalYear.java`:
- `of(LocalDate)` → the fiscal year integer (`month >= 7 ? year + 1 : year`)
- `label(LocalDate)` → the `FY<YY>` string

**Membership identifier's year segment now uses the fiscal year** (previously calendar year, `getYear() % 100`):
- `mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — `membershipNumber` expression, plus added `FiscalYear` to the mapper `imports`.
- `rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` — the duplicated membership-number builder used in the audit log, kept consistent.

**Tenure now counts elapsed fiscal years, not 365-day windows** — `model/MembershipLevel.java`:
- `tenureDays` (via `ChronoUnit.DAYS`) replaced with `tenureFiscalYears` = `FiscalYear.of(now) - FiscalYear.of(registrationDate)`.
- The `+3` bonus now applies for **more than 1** elapsed fiscal year (preserving the original "more than one year" threshold semantics).

**New `fiscalYear` response field** — `resources/openapi.yml`:
- Added the `fiscalYear` schema property (`FY<YY>`) on the owner DTO, mapped in `OwnerMapper` via `FiscalYear.label(...)`.
- Updated `membershipNumber` and `membershipPoints` descriptions to match the new fiscal-year semantics.
